messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — prototyping an ephemeral KMS proxy for SIEM consumers. Idea: don't give them broad bucket Reader role; instead mint 15m S3 presigned creds that require a short-lived KMS unwrap token. Looking for opinions on audit trail + retention impacts.
security-bot: New design note: ephemeral-keys-broker v1 deployed to staging. See /deploys/ephemeral-keys-broker/2026-03-18 ✅
priya: Nice. Two quick Qs — how do we record who requested the token (for forensics) and where do we store that request log? CloudTrail? internal audit stream?
lee: We should emit a minimal, immutable audit event to the security log pipeline for each token mint: requester, requester_ip, reason (free text or job id), token_id (sha256), ttl, kms_key_id. That lets us reconstruct without exposing plaintext keys. :+1:
ben: Important: retention policy for those mint events needs alignment with compliance. For PCI/PHI customers we may need 7 years? Check legal. For normal infra, 1 year may be enough. Also confirm whether these events go to the same SIEM export or a gated export.
anya: Also consider redaction: never log wrapped key material or presigned URLs. Log only their fingerprint/id. We can add a flag to redact user-provided reason if it contains PII — use regex and redact before emit.
sam: Implementation note: plan is to create an audit record to the secure-audit stream synchronously before issuing the presigned creds. Example emitted JSON (no secrets):
```
{"event":"kms_token_mint","requester":"sam","req_id":"r_123abc","token_id":"sha256:...","kms_key":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/xxx","ttl_s":900,"outcome":"issued"}
```
We'd push to secure-audit (WORM-retention) and to CloudTrail (for KMS unwrap events) — but we need to confirm retention class.
priya: For SIEM exports: do we export the secure-audit stream to Snowflake/third-party? If so, we must ensure exported rows are covered by the same KMS envelope key and that export consumers cannot decrypt the wrapped content beyond allowed fields. Prefer gating exports with ephemeral consumer credentials + attribute-based access.
lee: RBAC change suggestion: create a new role 'siem_export_consumer_ephemeral' that only calls the proxy API and can request presigned creds; they must present an approved integration id. No direct S3 or KMS perms. This keeps IAM surface minimal.
ben: Ops question — what happens on key rotation? If we rotate the KMS key, previously issued presigned URLs should remain valid until TTL expires; wrapped tokens must still be unwrap-able by a decryption key. We should add rotation compatibility checks in staging.
anya: On retention classes: recommend secure-audit stream be set to 3 years default, with an archival tier (WORM) for any events marked sensitive up to 7 years. That's configurable per-customer/legal.
sam: Action items: 1) Priya to confirm legal retention floors for targeted customers. 2) Lee to PR RBAC role + proxy auth checks. 3) Ben to add rotation e2e test. 4) Anya to add redaction rules. I'll sketch implementation and RFC. Anyone object to this plan?
priya: Sounds good. I'll ping legal and post back by EOD.
lee: I'll open the RBAC PR tomorrow and link the proxy design doc.
ben: I'll add tests to the key-rotation matrix.
anya: fine by me.
security-bot: Note: Creating RFC draft ticket INFSEC-4821: "Ephemeral KMS proxy for SIEM exports — audit & retention" (https://tracker.internal/INFSEC-4821).
